feeds.title: Horror Writers Association » Halloween
feeds.description: Jump into instructive articles, anecdotes, editorials, and informative information about Halloween and the Horror genre. The Horror Writers Association is a professional writers' organization for horror writers, dedicated to support, education, and community for writers in the horror genre.

feeds.title: Library Girl and Book Boy » Halloween
feeds.description: Jo Cummins is an experienced primary school teacher currently working with Hampshire's Primary Behaviour Service. Through my blog, she aims to introduce children, their families, teachers, and book lovers to books they may not have come across before but would enjoy reading or using in their school curriculums.

feeds.title: iLOVITTbooks Blog
feeds.description: Dive into iLOVITTbooks.com's Halloween & Christmas Book Blog, where you can find the best children's books to read this season. Their creative team has put together a list of the top picks for you and your family to read & enjoy.

feeds.title: Your Best Halloween Ever » Halloween Stories
feeds.description: Curl up with a sweet collection of original short stories, some a little scarier than others and all with a spooky vibe, perfect for reading at any time of year - especially in the days leading up to Halloween. Your Best Halloween Ever is a one-stop Halloween resource with a compendium of playlists, DIYs, costumes, stories, recipes, games and more.

feeds.title: The Incredibly Strange Creature » Halloween
feeds.description: Orrin Grey likes monsters and is the author of several spooky books. Delve into his Halloween Archives where he discusses his favorite Halloween books to read, glaze and share among your friends.

feeds.title: Rami Ungar The Writer » Halloween
feeds.description: Embark on a literary adventure that will take you beyond the candy bowl and into worlds of spooky thrills and delightful chills. Columbus, Ohio-based horror writer Rami Ungar showcases a macabre collection of short stories and other posts tagged Halloween in his blog to help you find good read.

feeds.title: What to Read to Your Kids » Halloween Stories
feeds.description: Step up your spooky book-reading game with these amazing Halloween stories. From cozy mysteries to giggle-inducing ghost stories, blogger The Book Mommy helps you find the perfect book to set the mood for a magical Halloween night.

feeds.title: Imogen's Typewriter » Halloween
feeds.description: Prepare to be spellbound by an enchanting collection of book recommendations in the Halloween Readathon! Imogen is a 26-year-old UK-based blogger. She's an English Literature and Creative Writing student, want-to-be writer, kitten fosterer, and general nerd.

feeds.title: Spooky Little Halloween » Halloween Book Club
feeds.description: Join the Halloween Book Club over at Spooky Little Halloween for spate of ghoulish tales. Spooky Little Halloween is a blog + magazine celebrating October 31st all year long. Author Miranda helps you find ideas and inspiration for decorating, DIYs, and parties as well as killer playlists, the best year-round shopping spots, and even a spooky recipe or two.
